description: Defines the BreakLockForm class for handling the form to break locks on views in Drupal's views_ui module.

classes.name: BreakLockForm
classes.description: Form class for breaking locks on views, extending EntityConfirmFormBase.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes entityTypeManager and tempStore.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Returns the confirmation question about breaking the lock.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides description about the lock and the user who owns it.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Returns URL to cancel the form.

methods.name: getConfirmText
methods.description: Returns the text for the confirmation button.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, showing message if no lock exists.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission to delete the lock and redirect.
